services.value: Cape Fear Analytical provides specialty analytical laboratory services focused on the analysis of Dioxins/Furans and PCB Congeners. Services listed include Dioxins/Furans analysis by SW846 Method 8290A, EPA Method 1613B, and EPA TO-9a, as well as PCB congener analyses by EPA Method 1668, plus dioxin/furan and PCB congener analysis under HRSM02.0 (EPA Contract Laboratory Program).
